decisions.reason: A semi-hard cheese wheel close to the core cheese range costs little to carry, and its promotion to a dedicated page in 2019 signals positive early resolution, so the option is still worth holding.

The spicy flavored cheese gained its own page in 2019, but the parallel flavored cheese B was dropped quickly, so its value is less certain; with low carrying costs in a narrow range it remains worth keeping for now.

The mild creamy soft cheese was featured at launch and given its own page, unlike the washed-rind soft cheese F that was dropped, suggesting it survived the initial shakeout and still justifies its modest carrying cost.
